newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-STEPHAN NAMED NEW BORDEAUX COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STEPHAN NAMED NEW BORDEAUX COACH.

text.p: Former Lyon coach Guy Stephan will take charge of Bordeaux in the coming French league season following the departure of Rolland Courbis to Marseille, the club said on Friday.
Stephan, 41, took over from Jean Tigana at Lyon in 1995 and guided them to the last 16 of the UEFA Cup where they went out to Nottingham Forest. He was sacked early last season.

Bordeaux, whose chief new signings are Brazilian midfielder Ricardinho from Parana and striker Lilian Laslandes from Auxerre, hold their first training session under Stephan next Thursday when the players report back after their holidays.
